label: The unique-optimum optimizing root is an alternative to WN
note: Rowe's rival named in WN's record (navigation, not attributed), stated on the root's giving at being level. With SS (85f3fea2) and a rational exercise toward a given being other than the root, it makes WN fail (G3 law 3): a perfect will fixed toward an effect its end does not require. Refuted conditionally by G1, which does not count (#999: its premises are open).
